response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS risk_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(risk_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(tc.risk_count) AS average_count, AVG(tc.risk_count - b.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS tc CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE tc.risk_count > b.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: The average across types includes only order types represented among matched risk/margin records.
